standard: Map a folder with cartogomancy to see its classes, complexity hotspots and unused exports. Maps are saved in ~/.mad/shellomancy/maps/ and, when you're signed in, sent to Inventorium so SwarmDesk can build the code city.

standard: When a mapped repo's default branch moves (a merge or pull) or a new version is tagged, map it again, and send it if uploads are on. At most once an hour per folder; commits on other branches never trigger it.
